summary: Iteration 11 — Verified new seed users, developer isolation, bank scoping, additive catalog growth (12 projects / 49 units), and data preservation from iteration_10. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_new_seed.py — 15/15 pytest PASSED. Backend: all 5 new logins (bankdki2, bankdki3 as btn_evaluator/Bank DKI; developer4/5/6 as admin_developer) succeed with correct role+bank. GET /api/developer/projects returns exactly {Cendana Asri Residence, Cendana Riverpark} for dev4, {Harmoni Land Semarang, Harmoni Waterfront City} for dev5, {Purnama Green Valley, Purnama Sky Residence} for dev6; original dev1/2/3 still 2 projects each. Cross-developer PUT /api/developer/projects/{id} => 403; cross-developer POST /api/developer/units => 403. bankdki2/bankdki3/bankdki all see only Bank DKI applications; btn@ sees only Bank BTN; cross-bank PATCH /api/kpr/applications/{id} (bankdki2 patching BTN app) => 403. Public GET /api/projects returns 12 projects with 49 total units. Iteration_10 KPR applications persist (BTN pre_approved + DKI pending both present). Frontend: landing page renders 12 project cards; city filter=Semarang correctly narrows to the 2 Harmoni Land projects. developer4 UI login redirects to /developer with only Cendana Asri Residence + Cendana Riverpark visible (no Harmoni/Purnama/Griya leakage). bankdki2 UI login redirects to /btn showing header 'Dashboard Analis Bank DKI', Total Pengajuan=1 (the Budi Santoso KOMERSIAL Bank DKI app seeded in iteration_10). All isolation, additive-seed, and data-preservation requirements confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remains ~1105 lines — carry-over recommendation from iteration_10 to split by resource routers.

Note: string 'Bank BTN' appears in the bank-evaluator dashboard body because the header/menu label 'Analis Bank BTN' is a static role option; body-level string search for 'Bank BTN' therefore matches even for DKI users. Not a bug — the dashboard title and data are correctly scoped — but a naive UI regression check by substring could be misleading. Consider gating the 'Analis Bank BTN' menu label by current user's bank.
